title: AI Customer Response Assistant
businessOutcomes: Faster, more consistent replies to customer questions.
summary: Draft on-brand replies to customer emails, form submissions, and chat messages for human review before sending.
businessProblem: Customer inquiries pile up during busy periods. Staff write inconsistent replies, slow response times hurt reviews, and the owner becomes the bottleneck for every customer message.
outcome: Draft responses appear within minutes of each inquiry, matching your business tone, answering the specific question, and flagging cases that need owner escalation.
expectedOutcomes: Draft responses appear within minutes of each inquiry, matching your business tone, answering the specific question, and flagging cases that need owner escalation.
whoItsFor: Small teams without a dedicated customer service rep — especially businesses getting 10–50 inbound messages per day across email, forms, and chat.
aiInputs: Incoming message text and sender metadata
Business tone guide (formal/casual, key phrases to use/avoid)
FAQ document or past approved replies as examples
Product/service catalog with pricing and availability
aiOutputs: Draft reply ready for human review
Escalation flag if message involves complaint, refund, or legal issue
Suggested internal note for CRM logging
Confidence score on whether FAQ fully answers the question
noCodeTools: Help Scout AI Draft or similar built-in AI reply tools
Zapier: form submission → OpenAI → Gmail draft
ChatGPT custom GPT trained on your FAQ doc
lowCodeTools: n8n: webhook on new form/email → OpenAI → draft creation
Front or Missive with AI compose integration
customBuildStack: RAG pipeline over FAQ and past replies (vector store)
OpenAI API with system prompt for tone and escalation rules
Gmail API draft creation or help desk API
implementationSteps: Document 20–30 example replies that represent your ideal tone
Build FAQ covering top 15 customer questions
Connect inbound channels (email, forms) to trigger workflow
Configure escalation rules: refunds, complaints, legal → notify owner, no auto-draft
Run in draft-only mode for 2 weeks — staff approve/edit every reply
Track edit rate; refine prompt when AI drafts need heavy editing
systemBehavior: Triggered on each new inbound message (near real-time)
Always creates drafts — never auto-sends without explicit approval setting
Escalation rules bypass AI and notify owner directly
Logs every draft and final sent version for quality review
Degrades gracefully if FAQ doesn't cover the question — flags gap instead of guessing
risks: AI may confidently state incorrect pricing or policy — verify all factual claims
Tone mismatch on sensitive complaints can escalate situations
Customer PII in prompts requires data handling policy
Staff may stop reading inquiries and blindly approve drafts
